firm_data.firm_description: Whitbeck Benedict & Smith LLP (formerly Rapport Meyers LLP) represents individuals, businesses, government entities, and community organizations throughout the Hudson Valley. Since 1936, the firm has maintained a diverse, sophisticated practice, assisting clients with transactions, litigation, and administrative proceedings.
notable_facts: The firm serves clients throughout the Hudson Valley.
The firm provides legal services for public entities, large corporate entities, and individuals.
